method: Full Alpaca operating-company universe -> resilient snapshot discovery without treating missing premarket quote/volume as illiquidity -> top 2,000 pre-history tournament -> top 800 daily-history analysis with 20-day average dollar-volume liquidity verification -> top 300 setup-specific BREAKOUT/PULLBACK/TREND validation -> strongest qualified names into Teststock optimizer. Live spread is always re-verified at execution.
